description: Track A item 2: per-session (per-day) risk control on cached item tables of Paper 1 (B2T '25 ours + published, guard on; sEMG calib / xsession / xsubject). Methods: global LTT max (baseline), Mondrian LTT (fallback never / global / mixture), session-start block (LTT, exact block test, empirical Bayes) with k labelled items as offer-only warm-up (W) or as feedback at the global threshold (F), online anytime-valid e-process monitor, ACI (online_risk, floor = global threshold). Settings fixed before the first run.
eb_sens_note: Added after an R = 3 smoke run showed that the kappa <= 100 prior shrinks day 34 to the pooled rate; labelled as a sensitivity analysis. Forward chain uses fc_prior_kappa for both.
feedback_model: zero delay; the truth of every item is known after its decision (commit: correction or no correction; offer: the pick). Silent errors are not modelled.

session_definition.B2T random re-splits: session = all non-fit items of one day (calibration + test items of the split), in file order; global threshold = LTT max on the calibration items of the OTHER days (leave-day-out); EB references = the other days' calibration items
session_definition.B2T forward chain V1: model fitted on days 1..k-2; global threshold = LTT max on day k-1; session = all of day k; EB prior mean = day k-1 risk at each lambda, kappa = fc_prior_kappa
session_definition.B2T forward chain V3: model fitted on days 1..k-1; global threshold = the fitted policy's plug-in commit_p (no held-out data); session = all of day k; EB prior Beta(alpha*kappa, (1-alpha)*kappa)
session_definition.sEMG random re-splits: session = the test items of one test participant (table order); global threshold = Paper 1 LTT max on the full calibration set; EB references = the other test participants (leave-one-out)
